cues: A sunflower a metre tall can stand on its primary tissues alone.
A sal tree thirty metres tall cannot.

text: A sunflower a metre tall can stand on its primary tissues alone. A sal tree thirty metres tall cannot. As a woody plant adds height and leaves, its young body can neither carry the load nor pipe enough water to the crown. So it adds girth.
